verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents a dedicated Compare mode for baseline vs. candidate (docs-12). Users register agent versions that record instructions, model, and tools, then compare them on the same tasks and starting state (docs-10, docs-29, docs-2). Frozen suite versions and frozen environments keep runs comparable (docs-13, docs-15), and recorded actions can be inspected to explain score differences (docs-2). Missing for 10: details of the side-by-side comparison view or automatic regression flagging, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
